items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 15 June 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic and high pressure over continental Europe as weak fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or southeast, veering south or southwest overnight, 2 to 4, increasing force 5 in western and central areas later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as areas of mist and fog patches soon developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, increasing mainly 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as areas of mist and fog patches, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain or mist and very poor in fog patches. Becoming mainly good later.
